script.text: Good morning! I'm Kelly, and this is your daily lesson for January 1. Today we're exploring two powerful ideas together.
Welcome to Day One.  Not just of this journey, but of something bigger.  Every moment offers a chance to begin again.

You've probably heard it takes 21 days to form a habit. That number? Made up in the 1960s. Real research from University College London found it takes 66 days on average—and varies widely by person and habit. The good news? Missing a day doesn't reset your progress. Neuroplasticity—your brain's ability to rewire itself—doesn't expire with age.  Whether you're 18 or 80, your neurons can form new connections.
Today's wisdom: Here's today's wisdom: You don't need January 1st to start fresh.  Every morning—every moment—is a chance to begin again.
Now let's take what we learned and put it into practice.
Today's growth challenge is Fresh Start - Setting Intentions.

Here's your activity: Write down one thing you want to learn or become better at this year. Put it somewhere you'll see it daily. Tomorrow, we'll build on this foundation. This helps you create a meaningful intention for your learning journey.
And here's how today's lessons connect: What you learned about starting fresh can be applied to fresh start - setting intentions. Practice makes progress.
That's today's lesson. Learn something, grow a little. I'll see you tomorrow with something new. Stay curious!
